title: PM-LLM-Benchmark: Evaluating Large Language Models on Process Mining Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Cross-validating scores by having multiple LLMs act as judges for answers generated by themselves and other models to detect if an LLM assigns disproportionately higher scores to its own outputs (Table 4).

Observing the scoring behavior of LLMs acting as judges to identify a systematic preference for verbose and detailed outputs, which inherently penalizes more concise responses from lower-performing LLMs.

Prompting models with process mining event logs (related to hiring, lending, renting, and hospital data) to test their ability to identify fairness-sensitive attributes and compare protected versus non-protected demographic groups (Benchmark Category C6).
